scripts.emulators:dev: npm run build:functions && firebase emulators:start --project demo-income-tracker --only auth,firestore,functions --import=.firebase-data --export-on-exit
scripts.build: npm run typecheck && electron-vite build && electron-builder
scripts.build:mac: npm run typecheck && electron-vite build && electron-builder --mac
scripts.build:win: npm run typecheck && electron-vite build && electron-builder --win
scripts.typecheck: tsc --noEmit -p tsconfig.node.json && tsc --noEmit -p tsconfig.web.json && tsc --noEmit -p tsconfig.test.json
scripts.test:rules: firebase emulators:exec --project demo-income-tracker --only firestore "npm run test -- --project rules --project integration --no-file-parallelism"
scripts.test:e2e: firebase emulators:exec --project demo-income-tracker --only firestore "npm run test -- --project e2e --no-file-parallelism"
scripts.test:functions: npm run build:functions && firebase emulators:exec --project demo-income-tracker --only auth,firestore,functions "npm run test -- --project functions --no-file-parallelism"
